tagline: Leading global provider of mobility solutions through Avis, Budget and Zipcar brands
hero_kpi_rationale: Consolidated revenue is the primary indicator of the company's size and overall performance in the mobility sector. It reflects demand for its car and truck rental and car-sharing services through a diversified brand portfolio operating in 180 countries.

kpis.name: Consolidated Revenues
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from car, truck, and car-sharing rental activities.
kpis.description: Consolidated revenue for 2025 amounted to $11.652 billion, a 1% decrease compared to the prior year (2024: $11.789 billion).
kpis.signal: Slight revenue decline, impacted by competition and economic conditions.

kpis.name: Net Loss
kpis.explanation: Total financial loss after deducting all expenses from revenues.
kpis.description: The company reported a net loss of $995 million in 2025, an improvement of 45% compared to 2024 (loss of $1.817 billion), primarily due to long-lived asset impairment charges of $518 million.
kpis.signal: Significant net loss, but improved from 2024, impacted by asset impairment charges related to electric vehicles.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Measure of operating performance before certain financial and non-recurring items, excluding fleet costs other than depreciation.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA for 2025 was $748 million, a key metric to assess operating performance before non-recurring and financial items.
kpis.signal: Positive adjusted EBITDA of $748 million, indicating sound underlying operating performance despite net loss.

kpis.name: Average Rental Fleet
kpis.explanation: Average number of vehicles available in the global rental fleet during the year.
kpis.description: The average global fleet stood at approximately 684,000 vehicles in 2025, stable compared to the prior year.
kpis.signal: Stable fleet size, indicating prudent asset management and strategic portfolio balance.

kpis.name: Vehicle Rental Transactions
kpis.explanation: Total number of vehicle rental transactions completed across all segments and brands.
kpis.description: Approximately 38 million vehicle rental transactions were completed worldwide in 2025.
kpis.signal: High transaction volume, reflecting sustained demand for rental services despite competitive pressures.

kpis.name: Long-lived Asset Impairment Charges
kpis.explanation: Costs related to the write-down of long-lived assets, primarily electric vehicles.
kpis.description: Asset impairment charges of $518 million were recorded in 2025, primarily related to the revised fleet strategy for electric vehicles in the United States, identified during the Q4 2025 review in connection with the Interpace Ventures transaction.
kpis.signal: Asset impairment charges of $518 million in 2025, down 79% from 2024 ($2.470 billion), related to EV strategy revision.

kpis.name: Americas Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from car and car-sharing rental operations in North, South, and Central America and the Caribbean.
kpis.description: Americas segment revenue for 2025 amounted to $8.900 billion, a 2.3% decrease compared to 2024 ($9.111 billion).
kpis.signal: Slight decline in Americas revenue in 2025, reflecting competitive pressures and fleet strategy changes.

kpis.name: International Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from car and car-sharing rental operations in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia, and Australasia.
kpis.description: International segment revenue for 2025 amounted to $2.752 billion, an 8.8% decrease compared to 2024 ($3.018 billion), representing weaker performance than the Americas segment.
kpis.signal: More pronounced decline in International revenue compared to Americas, impacted by economic conditions and foreign exchange fluctuations.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: Competition in the mobility industry is high, with price as a primary factor. Competitive pressures could reduce rental volume and impact operating results. Mentioned in the RISKS RELATED TO OUR INDUSTRY AND THE BROADER ECONOMY section of the 10-K report.

risks.title: Fleet Costs
risks.score_rationale: Fleet costs represent the largest expense category for the company and can vary based on vehicle purchase and resale prices. This is mentioned in the RISKS RELATED TO OUR INDUSTRY AND THE BROADER ECONOMY section of the 10-K report.

risks.title: Safety Recalls
risks.score_rationale: Safety recalls can impact the company's costs and revenues, as well as brand reputation. This is mentioned in the RISKS RELATED TO OUR INDUSTRY AND THE BROADER ECONOMY section of the 10-K report.

risks.title: Economic Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Economic fluctuations can significantly impact demand for vehicle rentals and operating results. Macroeconomic factors include interest rates, inflation, new vehicle costs, and used car values. This is mentioned in the RISKS RELATED TO OUR INDUSTRY AND THE BROADER ECONOMY section of the 10-K report.

risks.title: Political Instability
risks.score_rationale: Political instability, including military conflicts in the Middle East and Eastern Europe, can impact the company's costs and revenues. Mentioned in the RISKS RELATED TO THE NATURE OF OUR BUSINESS section of the 10-K report.

risks.title: Reputation
risks.score_rationale: The company's reputation is essential to its success and can be impacted by negative events, including safety issues and customer service. This is mentioned in the RISKS RELATED TO THE NATURE OF OUR BUSINESS section of the 10-K report.

risks.title: Distribution Channel
risks.score_rationale: Distribution channels can impact the company's sales and operating results. Dependence on licensing partners and airport locations creates operational risks. This is mentioned in the RISKS RELATED TO THE NATURE OF OUR BUSINESS section of the 10-K report.

risks.title: Seasonality
risks.score_rationale: Seasonality can impact the company's sales and operating results, with balanced demand patterns between weekday business and weekend leisure travel. This is mentioned in the RISKS RELATED TO THE NATURE OF OUR BUSINESS section of the 10-K report.

ai_positioning.summary: Avis Budget Group focuses on using analytics to improve operational efficiency and customer experience, rather than direct integration of generative AI into its core offerings. The company mentions accelerating innovation through disciplined technology investments, but without specific details on generative AI or machine learning.
evidence: strengthening operational efficiency, expanding the use of analytics, elevating the customer experience, and accelerating innovation through disciplined investment in technology
